en: A black‑and‑white view over a formal town square or park with young trees planted in a grid. Beyond the open space stands a row of substantial late‑19th‑century masonry buildings with steep tiled roofs, dormers, and decorative facades. One large central building has a grand staircase leading up from the street and resembles a municipal or school building. To the right is a freestanding villa‑like house with a rounded roofline. The scene is urban, orderly, and typical of a Central European town; there is no visible printed caption or writing.
